profile.description: At twenty Kieran gives up the online game and the guild he led, to take the job at the Hart.

anticipation.description: His father's hours at the plant are cut in the 2009 recession; the call-centre contract ends; his mother says the Hart is a job for life.

focal_change.description: He logs off for the last time, gives the guild to someone else and starts on the Hart's payments floor in May 2010.

adaptation.description: He becomes the reliable one, no trouble to anyone, and does not play again. The want to belong to a band that needed him goes quiet rather than away.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: Barbara's call and her card of twelve words break into Kieran's routine.

anticipation.description: A year of weeks with the same shape; Laura on nights; a promotion that means the same desk; he has started to feel the week as a weight in his chest on Sunday evenings.

focal_change.description: On 21 October 2019 his scam-check call reaches Barbara, who laughs at the script and asks who could switch off the machine he works in; on 1 November her letter arrives with the card and fifty pounds of bitcoin behind it.

adaptation.description: He does not declare the gift. The card lives behind his bus pass for four months, a secret that makes the routine feel like a costume.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: Kieran opens the wallet and falls into decentralized finance.

anticipation.description: The card in his wallet; the news on 12 March that bitcoin has halved in a day.

focal_change.description: That evening he types the twelve words into a wallet app, confirms with his thumb on the glass, and the balance and the public ledger behind it appear.

adaptation.description: Lockdown shrinks his world to a spare room; the yield-farming summer, the Sharehouse and six thousand pounds of his own savings pull him in. The map of the world he thought he knew grows edges, and past them is a game.

profile.description: The car plant where his father has worked since 1992 closes.

anticipation.description: The closure is announced in February 2019; his father talks about it at Sunday lunch as if it were weather.

focal_change.description: Production ends at the end of July 2021; his father, fifty-nine, is out of the only job he has had for thirty years.

adaptation.description: Kieran pays his parents' rent for three months from his gains; for once the rabbit hole feeds his family; it also makes the money feel like proof.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: In May 2022 the stablecoin holding the house deposit breaks.

anticipation.description: The deposit is in the savings protocol at about twenty percent; the market has been falling since November; the Sharehouse calls the stablecoin safe yield.

focal_change.description: From 9 May the stablecoin slips from its dollar and does not come back; by 13 May the deposit is worth about three thousand pounds and falling.

adaptation.description: Open until drawn: whether and when he tells Laura, what she does, what Barbara does, what Kieran does with the mind that took him in.

profile.description: The railway works close in 1986 and Barbara, thirty-three, loses her trade.

anticipation.description: Rundown and rumours; the men in her shop say a woman will be first to go.

adaptation.description: She retrains as a programmer at a college in 1987 and joins a Reading software bureau in 1988; she learns that institutions end and that she must be able to verify everything she depends on.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: Barbara watches the banking system come close to stopping in 2008.

anticipation.description: A bank run on the television in September 2007; stress in the clearing tests.

focal_change.description: In October 2008 banks are rescued by the state; the software she wrote keeps waiting for money that may not arrive.

adaptation.description: She reads the bitcoin paper in 2011, buys her first coins in 2013 when she retires, and becomes a purist: a ledger nobody can switch off.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: Barbara moves her remaining savings out of the Hart.

anticipation.description: She is sixty-six; she decides not to keep anything in a system she helped build and no longer trusts.

focal_change.description: On 21 October 2019 she sends forty thousand pounds to a crypto exchange; the scam rules stop it and a young man calls to check on her.

adaptation.description: The young man's voice stays with her. She sends him a card with twelve words, the way her father gave her his tools, and then waits to see whether he will look.

provenance: rabbit-hole-run; authored by the calling LLM under the human's delegation

profile.description: At twelve Laura's family is moved on from a rented house for the fifth time.

anticipation.description: The landlord's letters; her mother's silence at the kitchen table.

focal_change.description: In summer 2003 they leave the house in Highworth she thought was theirs.

adaptation.description: She stops unpacking her room fully and resolves to own a front door nobody can take; she learns from her mother to hold everything together and say nothing.

profile.description: The first pandemic wave on the intensive-care unit.

anticipation.description: News from Italy; the unit rehearses; she buys a second set of scrubs.

focal_change.description: From late March 2020 the unit fills with ventilated patients; she works nights and sleeps in the day.

adaptation.description: She becomes steady and absent; she stops telling Kieran about her shifts because there are no words that do not frighten him.

profile.description: The January 2021 wave, the worst weeks of the pandemic.

anticipation.description: Numbers rising through December; Christmas cancelled.

focal_change.description: In January 2021 the unit is beyond capacity; she sits in the car outside the flat for twenty minutes after shifts before coming up.

adaptation.description: She wants a house more than ever, as the one thing that is not the unit; she has no attention left for what Kieran does at night.
